kjv: the prince whom thine eyes have seen
mine: What your eyes have seen / do not hastily bring into court
note: The clause 'asher ra'u 'eneykha can close v. 7 (KJV) or open v. 8 as the object of "bring to court"; the latter gives v. 8 its missing object.
Hebrew maskiyyot means carved work or settings (filigree); "pictures" in 1611 meant images, which now misleads.

kjv: The north wind driveth away rain
mine: The north wind brings forth rain
note: Hebrew techolel means "brings forth, produces" (as in birth); the KJV reverses it to "drives away" and inverts the second line so the angry face drives off the backbiter, when the Hebrew says the backbiting tongue produces angry looks.
